title: Category Diversity per Author
scenario: Find authors who have published in at least 5 different categories and have an average of > 100 views per article.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, author_id INT, category_id INT), page_views (article_id INT, views_count INT)
hint: Group by author, count categories, then average views.
correctQuery: SELECT author_id FROM (SELECT author_id, COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) as cat_count, AVG(total_views) as avg_views FROM (SELECT author_id, category_id, article_id, SUM(views_count) as total_views FROM articles JOIN page_views USING (article_id) GROUP BY author_id, category_id, article_id) t GROUP BY author_id) t2 WHERE cat_count >= 5 AND avg_views > 100;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, author_id INT, category_id INT); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, views_count INT);
